items.text: DuraPro ABS CF is a carbon fiber-reinforced high-performance ABS filament designed for technical applications where maximum stiffness, dimensional stability, and heat resistance are required.
Thanks to its low warping tendency, DuraPro ABS CF is ideal for functional parts, prototypes, and use in mechanical engineering.
High stiffness and mechanical strength due to carbon fiber reinforcement
The addition of carbon fibers significantly increases the material’s mechanical strength and improves its thermal performance compared to standard ABS.

DuraPro ABS CF offers greater stiffness and improved heat resistance than standard ABS, thanks to carbon fiber reinforcement, while also being genuinely lighter in weight. As with all carbon-fiber-reinforced materials, this added rigidity comes with reduced elongation at break compared to standard ABS, making it best suited to applications where stiffness matters more than flexibility.

items.text: Fiber-reinforced composite filaments are the ideal material for end-use parts production and heavy-duty applications that require superior strength, stiff and heat resistance.

Jigs and Fixtures

End-use parts
Housings and enclosures

During high speed printing, Hyper Core ABS CF15 inherits excellent impact toughness, good chemical resistance and low moisture absorption of terpolymer ABS matrix, moreover special fiber-distrubution improves the Z-direction strength, stiffness as well as the nozzle lifetime.
Carbon fiber-reinforced material with balanced properties and wide range of uses

To overcome these challenges, Raise3D’s Hyper Core ABS CF15 filament is specially developed utilizing special extrusion technology to form a fiber-rich inner core where most of the carbon fibers are well-aligned and distributed.
During high-speed FFF printing, the outstanding heat conductivity of carbon-fiber core accelerates filament melting in the hot end.
The Hyper Core ABS CF15 filament is designed for a fast-melting rate as well as balancing print quality, performance and cost.
Hyper Core ABS CF15 inherits excellent impact toughness, good chemical resistance and low moisture absorption of terpolymer ABS matrix.
Developed for Hyper FFF ®
Tailored fiber distribution
Superior strength and stiffness
High Speed Printing
Easy Post-processing
Easy to Print
However, printing fiber-reinforced filament at high speed brings many challenges, such as lower flowability and poorer interlayer bonding quality, as well as the quicker wearing-out of the nozzle.
Dimensional stability

Ready for polishing and acetone vapor smoothing
Moreover, the residual thermal energy of the fiber-rich inner core promotes the interlayer bonding of ABS across the adjacent lines to form a smooth and strong part.
Moreover, special fiber distribution improves the Z-direction strength and stiffness, in addition to the prolonging the life of the nozzle.
Excellent interlayer bonding
Raise3D Hyper Core ABS CF15 Filament (2.5 kg) was designed to be used while inside the sealed bag, so please do not unseal it.
Filament bag keeps the filament dry

Lower nozzle abrasion

Using an abrasion-resistant nozzle, at minimum a Steel nozzle should be used or preferably, a SiC nozzle.
